property_summary: After calling settle() the reference always clears the caller's stored guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, while the mutant may leave it non-zero (it increments it) allowing a subsequent lockInGuess to be blocked — so the property: settle() makes guesses[msg.sender].block == 0 for all callers and inputs.
change_summary: Replace the zero-reset assignment with setting block to guesses[msg.sender].block + 1, changing the stored block value after settle.
